subject: ddl: cancel the job context before rolling back (#64130)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent with focus on add-index reorg/rollback + DXF disttask coordination in `pkg/ddl`. The change explicitly cancels an active `jobContext.stepCtx` when a job enters rolling back (fixing the reorg-timeout -> rollback resource/task leak window), refactors disttask pause/cancel polling into a helper, and adds failpoints + a realtikv integration test to cover cancel-after-timeout. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, concurrency, or DDL state-machine/metadata handling within scope.
